verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a cloud SaaS accounting product like QuickBooks Online, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or residency. The sandbox/production environment switch is an integration-testing control, not a data-location choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
